mechanism: Carbamazepine induces CYP3A4 and may alter renal handling of potassium; carbamazepine can cause hyponatremia which affects potassium regulation, and both drugs may be used concurrently in cardiac/neurological conditions requiring monitoring.
action: Monitor serum potassium and sodium levels regularly; adjust potassium supplementation based on laboratory values and clinical status; assess for symptoms of hypokalemia or hyperkalemia.
